dimensions.assessment: Affects federal and non-federal participants in the Lower Colorado River Multi-Species Conservation Program across Arizona, California, and Nevada.
dimensions.evidence: a cooperative effort between federal and nonfederal entities in Arizona, California, and Nevada.

dimensions.assessment: Administrative change establishing an interest-bearing account and fund transfer rules for existing non-federal program contributions.
dimensions.evidence: There is established in the Treasury of the United States a fund... consisting of any amounts deposited in the Fund... and any interest earned

dimensions.assessment: Involves investment in U.S. obligations and interest accumulation on non-federal funds without new federal appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: Investments under subparagraph (A) may be made only in interest-bearing obligations of the United States.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009 to add a specific financial management provision for one conservation program.
dimensions.evidence: Section 9402 of the Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009... is amended by adding at the end the following

dimensions.assessment: Permanent establishment of the funding account for ongoing program contributions.
